746790101.text: Take your positions, form ranks, muskets up, take aim, and fire! Repel the enemy advance!

746790102.text: Come take part in the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol's special event, and experience the joy of being a musket sharpshooter!

746790105.text: Not a concept we're too familiar with...

746790106.text: Looking at the stall this Garde set up, Paimon can't help but wonder what the event she mentioned could possibly have to do with the Fontinalia Film Festival...?

746790107.text: Ah, it's the Super Zenith Boss-Level Forces! What in the blazes are you doing here?

746790108.text: If you two help me promote my booth, I'll be able to hit my quota for sure!
